invariants.contract: POST /api/tags/rename answers 401 without a token and 403 for a non-admin and changes nothing. POST /api/tags/rename answers 400 when the old or new value is missing or empty and changes nothing. Renaming onto a value some item already has merges: no duplicate is stored, the response says merged, and the count covers items that had the old value. Renaming a value that no item has (matching is case-sensitive) answers 200 with numItemsUpdated 0 and changes nothing. After renames, GET /api/tags and the library filter data show the new values and no longer the old ones.
Repeating a finished rename updates no item and emits no event; the merged flag stays true because items already hold the new value.
Renaming a value to a new name rewrites it in every book and podcast row and in each item's metadata.json, and reports tagMerged/genreMerged false with the item count.
A rename emits item_updated with the new values to every user who can access each changed item and to nobody else.
